sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the creation of "groom and bride" refers to supernal spiritual levels, and that through the work of Israel below, especially by bringing joy to a groom and bride, one affects both above and below, ultimately leading to a higher elevation than at the beginning of creation, which will be revealed with the coming of Moshiach.

translations.translation: And this is "who created joy and gladness, groom and bride," etc.,
which refers
(also)
to the creation of the supernal groom and bride
(from whom the lower groom and bride are drawn down).
And that they are called by the name groom and bride

(for the name by which it is called in the Holy Tongue indicates the inner content of the thing, and even that it is the one that brings into being, enlivens, and sustains the thing, according to the well-known teaching of the Baal Shem Tov67),
is,
because "groom" (chasan) is from the term "chos" (degree), as explained above
(section 3),
and "bride" (kallah) is from the term "kilyon" (cessation) and from the term "kalta nafshi" (my soul yearns)68
[which are two aspects within the bride,
as explained in Likkutei Torah69].
And the intention in the creation of the supernal groom and bride is so that from them the lower groom and bride may be drawn down,
and as explained above
(section 3)
in the interpretation of the verse "For I said, 'The world is built with kindness,'" that the building of the Sefirah of Chessed is in order that there should be the coming into being of the world.
Therefore, through the service of Israel below, and particularly in this matter of bringing joy to the groom and bride
(in their simple, literal sense below),
through this they effect both above and below,
to the extent that it becomes "Gladden the beloved companions as You gladdened Your creation in the Garden of Eden from before"70
(before the sin)
when the world was in its fullness71,
"These are the generations of the heavens and the earth when they were created"72,
"generations" is full73.
And moreover,
since the intention of the descent
(of the world)
that occurred through the sin of the Tree of Knowledge is for the sake of an ascent,
it is therefore understood that the ascent is to a place higher than it was before the descent,
and therefore,
through the service
(after the sin)
there will be an ascent even more elevated than it was at the beginning of creation,
"These are the generations of Peretz"74,
"generations" is full73,
for the "generations is full" in this verse is higher than the "generations is full" at the beginning of creation.
And the revelation of this ascent will be at the coming of Moshiach our righteous one,
as it concludes there
(in the generations of Peretz75)
"and Yishai begot Dovid,"
Dovid, the King Moshiach.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section states that this revelation will come very soon, through our service during the six thousand years of the world and particularly through the spreading of the wellsprings of Chassidus, leading to the marriage of the Holy One and the Jewish people in complete perfection.

translations.translation: And this revelation will be very soon, and speedily in our days,
with kindness and mercy and with revealed and manifest good,
through our deeds and service during the six76
thousand years that the world has existed77
[which includes the aspect of time
(six thousand years)
and the aspect of place
(the world)
together],
and particularly through the service of "Your wellsprings will spread forth,"
the wellsprings of the Baal Shem Tov's teachings,
and particularly as they were revealed by the Alter Rebbe after Yud-Tes Kislev
[as is known the statement of the Rebbe
(the Rebbe Rashab)
of blessed memory78
that the matter of "Your wellsprings will spread forth to the outside" began primarily after Petersburg],
for through this "the Master, that is the King Moshiach, will come"79
for then there will be the marriage of the Holy One, blessed be He, and the Congregation of Israel80,
and also the marriage of the Holy One, blessed be He, and each individual of Israel,
in complete perfection,
as explained at length in many places81
on the verse82

"As in the days of your exodus from the land of Egypt, I will show him wonders," that the matters of the future will be wonders—nun (fifty) wonders—even relative to the miracles and wonders of the Exodus from Egypt,
for then the matter of the marriage will be in perfection,
very soon,
speedily in our days.
